description: Use after dp_get_tool for 'what else is like X?': returns other tools in the same directory category with DP picks first, then A to Z, excluding X. X must be a directory slug; for a product the directory doesn't list, use dp_find_alternatives.

slug.description: Tool slug to find peers for, e.g. 'signal'.

name: dp_get_related_tools
title: Get related tools (same category)
